about: DIRT 5 Unlocked - curated hidden command-line options of game_release.exe 1.0.276760.537 (full table: docs/dirt5-cli-options.txt). status: verified = seen working in-game; no-effect = accepted but did nothing in the release build (tested in-game, probably dev-build only); untested = accepted by the option table, effect not checked yet. nosave: unlock-type options force --nosave so free/unlocked items can't leak into the real profile.

options.label: Micro Machines top-down camera
options.help: Enables the Micro Machines Camera during gameplay
options.tested: 2026-09-26: normal chase camera in a Land Rush race

options.label: Hide HUD (no on-screen display)
options.help: Prevent the OSD from being displayed.
options.tested: 2026-09-26: HUD fully hidden (clock, positions, speedometer, minimap)

options.label: Freeze time of day
options.help: Pause the environment controller

options.label: Force the crowd on
options.help: Force the crowd on (it is otherwise controlled via EvoTweak)

options.label: Autopilot - the AI drives your car
options.help: If present, puts the player under AI control

options.label: No AI opponents
options.help: Disable the AI

options.label: No 'wrong way' reset rule
options.help: Disables Wrong way RTT Rule in all game modes

options.label: End every event after 15 s
options.help: End the event prematurely after 15 seconds

options.label: Skip racing, finish 1st
options.help: Skips racing playing state and should always finish the primary player in first.

options.label: P1 picks the cars for everyone (splitscreen)
options.help: Controls all the players in vehicle selection page with primary player input

options.label: No controller rumble
options.help: Turn off all haptic feedback

options.label: Everything purchasable is free
options.help: Make all purchasable items free

options.label: All items unlocked
options.help: Make all items auto unlocked
options.tested: 2026-09-26: rank-locked liveries (Lancia 037 livery 02/03, rank 15) selectable on a rank-01 profile

options.label: All entitlement cars/items
options.help: Unlocks all entitlement controled objects (vehicles, player card items etc)

options.label: Whole career unlocked
options.help: Sets all of Career to unlocked

options.label: Debug vehicles selectable
options.help: Allow debug vehicles to be selected for a race

options.label: AMD Citroen C3 + AMD sponsor rep
options.help: Requested by AMD. Unlocks the Citroen C3 and grants full sponsor rep with AMD

options.label: Show all 3 rewards after events
options.help: Shows the max(3) amount of rewards for each category that can be shown in the post event rewards sequence

options.label: FPS / CPU / GPU / build overlay
options.help: Show a FPS/CPU/GPU/Build Info window.

options.label: Render resolution overlay
options.help: Show a Render/History/Display resolutions Info window.
options.tested: 2026-09-26: no resolution overlay (FPS overlay from releasefps only)

options.label: No music
options.help: Don't play any music

options.label: Skip intro videos
options.help: Skip videos

options.label: Skip legal screens
options.help: Skip legals screens

options.label: Skip first-time tutorial
options.help: Skip First Time User Experience sequence

options.label: No 'servers lost' popups
options.help: Disable the fruit-coded network error messages

options.label: No DLC upsell popups
options.help: Stops the upsell notifications from being shown in the front end.

options.label: No health warning screen
options.help: Don't show the health warning

options.label: No inactivity warning
options.help: Disable the inactivity check

options.label: Don't save the profile
options.help: Don't do any saving of profile data
